interpretations: For each row in `constructors`, count its matching `constructorStandings` records, using 0 when there are none. Average those counts across all constructors, including those with 0. Return the 10 constructors whose counts exceed the average by the greatest amount, showing `constructorId`, `nationality`, record count, and the unrounded count minus average, ordered by that difference descending.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality,
         COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count
  FROM constructors AS c
  LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs
    ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
  FROM counts
)
SELECT counts.constructorId,
       counts.nationality,
       counts.record_count,
       counts.record_count - average_count.avg_count AS difference
FROM counts
CROSS JOIN average_count
WHERE counts.record_count > average_count.avg_count
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
